CPU_direct_full_question_local_search_pr.interpretation: Search with raw question, NOT model-actual search queries. This is a reachability upper-signal, not proof model saw a support source.

decision: Reject for training; 3 paired answers had ZERO additional tool calls, so their equality/no uplift cannot identify marginal tool value. Instrument model-generated actual search->read observations and compare availability/activation before any QLoRA.
limitations: Previously unseen within public HotpotQA validation only; public pretraining overlap unverified, native GAIA tools differ from local search/read proxy.
